```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
titanic = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a count plot of survival by class and sex
sns.countplot(data=titanic, x='class', hue='survived', palette='viridis')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Survival Count by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(fontsize=10)
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)

# Add legend
plt.legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'], loc='upper right')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
